$comment: How the popup shows the settings: groups (in order), labels and help. Settings not listed here appear under 'Advanced', so a new setting is never hidden. Keys use dots for nesting (engine.maxPasses).

groups.title: When to compile on the server

statusPosition.label: Position
statusPosition.help: Drag the chip in the page to place it freely.

statusDelayMs.label: Show after
statusDelayMs.help: Quick compiles don't show the chip at all.

fallbackToServer.label: Compile on the server if a local compile can't run
fallbackToServer.help: E.g. engine errors. Off: show the error instead.

serverOnMissingPackages.label: …if TeX Live packages are missing locally

localTimeoutSeconds.label: …if a local compile takes longer than

remoteEndpoint.label: Package server
remoteEndpoint.help: Single files by name. Empty: off.

engine.fetchFromCtan.label: Download whole TeX Live packages from CTAN
engine.fetchFromCtan.help: For files the package server lacks.

engine.fetchMissingFonts.label: Fetch fonts asked for by name (fontspec)

engine.downloadTimeoutSeconds.label: Give up on a download after

engine.maxPasses.label: TeX passes per compile at most

engineIdleMinutes.label: Close the engine when unused for

serverOnShellEscape.label: …if the document needs shell escape
serverOnShellEscape.help: minted, svg, gnuplot: the local engine can't run external programs.

engine.persistCacheMB.label: Keep downloads and converted fonts up to
engine.persistCacheMB.help: Makes the first compile after a browser restart faster. 0: off.
